narr: A cluster of thunderstorms resulted in isolated flash flooding in portions of the Mid-Hudson Valley on the 8th. A road was closed and a vehicle was stranded in floodwaters.
ev: A road was closed due to water over the roadway.
An occupied vehicle was stranded in flooded waters on Hunterstown Road in the town of Germantown.
lsr: ROAD CLOSED DUE TO WATER OVER ROADWAY.
OCCUPIED VEHICLE STRANDED IN FLOOD WATER ON HUNTERSTOWN RD IN TOWN OF GERMANTOWN.
